name: perfect-vibecoding-ram-management
description: Keeps a developer PC from freezing when AI agents, builds and tests share its memory: a machine-wide queue that runs heavy jobs one by one under memory caps, a watchdog that stops the newest AI-started job before the memory runs out, and hooks that refuse new agents and unqueued heavy commands when memory is low. Linux fully, macOS without caps.

watchdog.title: Start the RAM watchdog with each session
watchdog.description: At each session start, start the watchdog if it is not running. It is one small bash process that reads the memory every 2 seconds and keeps running after the session ends.

stop_jobs.title: Let the watchdog stop AI-started jobs when memory is critical
stop_jobs.description: When off, the watchdog only logs and warns. Applies to a watchdog that this plugin starts; one that already runs keeps its setting.
